news.title: Ford unveils the GT41 as it hopes to win Le Mans again
paras: contains Matt Damon inside Ford unveils the GT41 as it hopes to win Le Mans again Ford enters the World Endurance Championship in 2027 with the new prototype. The GT40 (right) won Le Mans 1966-1969; now Ford wants to add some more.

It could never replicate the GT40’s success winning overall, but it celebrated the 40th anniversary with a class win . Now it wants another shot at the really big trophy , and it debuted the car during the Detroit Lions-Chicago Bears football game today: meet the GT41.

sport.title: Why Carlos Alcaraz now deserves even more credit for splitting with Juan Carlos Ferrero after winning the ATP
paras: Around this time last year, it was announced that Carlos Alcaraz and Juan Carlos Ferrero would be ending their partnership together. It marked the conclusion of a hugely successful professional relationship, with the latter having helped guide his young compatriot to six Grand Slam titles and world number one, among many other accolades.

Many were left perplexed by this decision, especially considering it was coming off the back of a year where he had added another two majors to his trophy cabinet. It’s fair to say that now, roughly 12 months on from that bombshell decision, Carlos Alcaraz can feel confident that he made the right move.

sport.title: Looking back at Leon Smith’s first outing as Great Britain’s Davis Cup captain 16 years ago ahead of his 2026
paras: The British Davis Cup captain has led his team to the Davis Cup semi-finals. The nation secured a 2-1 victory over Germany in Thursday’s quarter-final following wins for Cameron Norrie and doubles duo Henry Patten and Neal Skupski. Great Britain will play Spain or Austria in the semi-finals on Saturday.

If the nation advances to the final, they will face either Italy or Czechia. Around 16 years ago, Smith found the British Davis Cup team in a much different stage of their development. It would be fair to say that the British team were on the brink of disaster when Smith assumed the position of captain in April 2010.

sport.title: Jodar and Merida send Spain into Davis Cup semi-finals against Great Britain
paras: Rafael Jodar came back from a set down against Jurij Rodionov to clinch Spain’s 2-0 win over Austria, after Daniel Merida had beaten Joel Schwaerzler. Carlos Alcaraz did not need to play. Spain reached the semi-finals of the Davis Cup Final 8 on Thursday in Bologna.

Rafael Jodar beat Jurij Rodionov 2-6, 6-0, 6-1 in 1 hour 31 minutes to clinch a 2-0 win over Austria, after Daniel Merida beat Joel Schwaerzler 6-4, 6-4 in 1 hour 19 minutes. The six-time champions will face Great Britain on Saturday. The doubles between Lucas Miedler and Neil Oberleitner and Carlos Alcaraz and Marcel Granollers was not played.

sport.title: Jamie Murray gives his honest opinion on the current Davis Cup format
paras: Home and away ties are, for many, what makes the Davis Cup . Gerrard Pique’s Kosmos group scrapped the famous format in favour of a week-long ‘Finals’ event in 2019, similar to that of the World Cup.

The partnership between the Kosmos group and the Davis Cup was terminated in 2023. The ‘Davis Cup Finals’ still exists, but the home-and-away ties are back for qualifiers and playoffs. While watching Great Britain play Germany in the Davis Cup quarter-finals, in Bologna, 2015 champion Jamie Murray delivered his honest verdict on the current format.

paras: Carlos Alcaraz said he missed Jannik Sinner after the Italian underwent surgery and withdrew from the 2027 Australian Open. “Obviously, I’m going to say tennis misses him. We haven’t seen each other since April.
